reason: Missing adult; an accidental fall into the river is suspected, not established.
description_en: Since Saturday morning, a 37-year-old man in Bremen-Mitte has been reported missing by his relatives. The 37-year-old had attended a party on an event ship on the Weser river in the Old Town early Saturday morning. According to witness statements, the man went outside to smoke around 6:30 a.m. The missing person was last seen at that time on the upper deck of the club boat. A relative alerted the police when the 37-year-old did not appear shortly thereafter at the agreed meeting point at Tiefer and also had not yet returned home. Based on current information, the police assume an accident occurred, with the 37-year-old presumably falling into the Weser river between the pier and the ship. All search efforts have so far been unsuccessful. Fire department divers were also deployed in the area of the pier.
technical_follow_up_note_not_human_label: Source reports a missing adult and suspected accident, not an established death; verify the uncertainty/death boundary.

reason: Deliberately thrown motorway object caused vehicle damage; attempted homicide and road danger are both central.
description_en: In the night leading up to Saturday, previously unknown perpetrators threw a dirt trap basket from a manhole onto the A27 motorway at the level of Neue Vahr Südost. Nobody was injured, two cars were damaged. The police are looking for witnesses.At approximately 03:05 AM, a 54-year-old man was driving his van on the A27 in the direction of Hanover. As his truck passed under the overpass at Neuwieder Straße, he saw an object falling in front of his car. Despite an evasive maneuver onto another lane, a collision occurred with the still-falling dirt trap basket from a manhole. A 52-year-old car driver with three other occupants, driving behind him, also tried to swerve, but ran over the basket and came to a stop on the hard shoulder.All involved remained uninjured. Property damage occurred to both vehicles.The criminal police are now investigating for attempted murder and dangerous interference with road traffic. The police are looking for witnesses.
technical_follow_up_note_not_human_label: Source describes vehicle damage and an attempted-murder/road-danger investigation; discuss one primary category rather than treating damage as the whole incident.

reason: Suspects broke into a bank branch and tried to break open its ATM.
description_en: Unknown perpetrators unsuccessfully attempted to break open an ATM in Vegesack during the night from Thursday to Friday. However, the burglars caused significant property damage. The thieves broke into the self-service branch of a bank in Lerchenstraße and tried to crack the ATM. When this failed, they fled empty-handed, but left behind a damaged entrance door and a destroyed interior. The damage is estimated at more than 40,000 Euros.
technical_follow_up_note_not_human_label: Source explicitly describes bank entry and a failed ATM break-in; no explosion is stated. Investigate the report-level burglary versus explosion mapping.

reason: Group threatened and beat teenager while taking items from his bag.
description_en: Unknown perpetrators attacked a 15-year-old on Sunday evening in Huchting near a shopping center. The group of six attackers threatened the minor with a supposed firearm and then punched and kicked him. The police are looking for witnesses.On Sunday evening, the 15-year-old from Bremen was approached by a young man unknown to him at the Rolandcenter bus stop. Under a pretext, this person lured him near a shopping center. There, further accomplices were already waiting for the minor.One of the perpetrators held a supposed firearm to the 15-year-old's head. The boy did not comply with the demand to hand over his wallet. Thereupon, one of the attackers pulled him to the ground. The unknown individuals collectively punched and kicked him. Meanwhile, one person searched his bag and stole cash as well as other items.The victim suffered severe head injuries. He subsequently had to be treated as an inpatient in the hospital.Two of the perpetrators are said to be approximately 16-18 years old. One of them wore a baseball cap backward during the crime.
technical_follow_up_note_not_human_label: Source describes threats, violence and property taking; investigate whether robbery is primary rather than the generic assault topic.

reason: School intruders caused vandalism; no meaningful theft established despite entry.
description_en:
Unknown persons ran riot in an elementary school in Gröpelingen over the weekend. They threw eggs at the walls, emptied fire extinguishers, and left behind a trail of devastation.

The vandals broke into the school building on Pastorenweg between Friday and Sunday. After they completed their mischief with eggs and extinguishing foam, some sweets were also consumed. The intruders fled undetected, and the damage is estimated at 10,000 Euros. Regular classes for the students had to be cancelled today.

The Bremen police have already secured several clues and are asking anyone who made suspicious observations around the school grounds over the weekend to come forward.
technical_follow_up_note_not_human_label: Source emphasizes school vandalism after entry; discuss the burglary/theft-intent versus property-damage rule.

title_en: Police officers stop man armed with a knife
reason: Man threatened responding officers while holding a knife; no injury required for threats.
description_en: Operational forces of the Bremen Police, the Federal Police, and employees of the Public Order Office and DB-Sicherheit stopped a 21-year-old man near the main train station on Thursday morning, as part of the so-called Quattro Patrol. He had previously been walking around with a drawn utility knife and had threatened the police officers with it. At approximately 10:35 AM, the Quattro Patrol intended to check the 21-year-old at Bahnhofsplatz due to prior intelligence, whereupon he drew a utility knife, stood up, and walked away. The officers stopped the man near the Old Post Office, where he repeatedly approached them and threatened them. For this reason, a Federal Police officer had to draw his service weapon and threaten its use. Subsequently, the 21-year-old threw away the knife and allowed himself to be arrested. No one was injured. He was taken to a psychiatric clinic and provisionally forcibly admitted there.

reason: Public-search update describes repeated bank-account fraud using false identity documents.
description_en:
Following several fraud offenses, the public prosecutor's office and the Bremen police were searching for a suspected perpetrator using photos; see also our press release no. 0255. The wanted woman subsequently turned herself in at a police station.
From August to September 2023, the woman opened at least seven bank accounts under a false identity, using stolen and falsified identity cards. Further investigations against her are ongoing.
The search has been concluded; the photos are to be deleted.

reason: Pepper spray injured six pupils; investigation concerns bodily harm.
description_en: A teenager sprayed pepper spray in a school building in Walle on Friday afternoon, injuring six students and then fleeing. Firefighters and paramedics initially responded to the school on Ellmersstraße with a large contingent. The injured individuals found suffered irritations in the eye area and were treated on site. One female student had to be taken to a hospital for further examination as a precautionary measure. After appropriate ventilation by the fire department, school operations could subsequently resume. Investigations into the perpetrator for dangerous bodily harm are ongoing.

reason: Original case concerns theft following entry into the victim’s cellar.
description_en: Police officers from Bremen police apprehended a 46-year-old man in Neustadt on Tuesday evening. They found in his possession the stolen goods from a burglary that had also occurred in Neustadt in mid-February.On Tuesday afternoon, a 33-year-old man reported to the police that he had recognized high-quality game figures and game boards being offered for sale on an online sales platform. These had been stolen from him in mid-February when unknown persons had broken into his cellar. After consulting with the criminal police, he feigned interest in buying the items. Police officers accompanied him to the meeting point. On site, the items were found by officers in the apartment of the 46-year-old suspected burglar.They took the man to the station and filed a corresponding report. Further investigations are ongoing.

reason: Taxi drivers were threatened and money was taken.
description_en: This week, two further robberies against taxi drivers occurred in Oslebshausen. In December, similar cases had already occurred, see our press releases 0841, 0846. The police are intensifying their measures and are looking for further witnesses. A previously unknown perpetrator got into taxis in Oslebshausen last week, threatened the drivers and stole cash, we reported. Now, late on Tuesday evening and this Friday morning, two further robberies of this kind occurred in the area of Am Nonnenberg street. After the robber stole cash, he fled undetected. The perpetrator is said to be between 25 and 40 years old. He was darkly dressed and wore jeans at the time of the crime. Most recently, he wore a bandage on his right hand. The police are intensifying their search and investigation measures. The criminal police are investigating and checking for links to the previous crimes. Initial witnesses were interviewed, and traces and evidence were secured.

reason: Repeated deliberate slashing of car tyres; no theft described.
description_en:
After a series of acts of vandalism to vehicles, the Bremen police were able to achieve a quick investigative success: A 41-year-old Bremen resident was identified as the suspected perpetrator.

The Bremen police had once again significantly increased their presence in the city area after the incidents. Last night, several dozen police officers were additionally deployed. In parallel, the special commission "Tyre Stabber" evaluated extensive evidence - including video footage, secured traces, and tips from the public, some of which had also been received anonymously via the tip portal. These investigations finally led to the 41-year-old suspect.

By order of the Bremen public prosecutor's office, the man's apartment in Bremen-Neustadt was searched. The suspect has not yet been apprehended. Further search operations and investigations are ongoing.

Senator for the Interior Ulrich Mäurer: "I am relieved that our police were able to achieve an important investigative success through intense investigative work and increased presence in the city area. The citizens contributed significantly with their valuable tips to identifying the suspect. The manhunt for the suspect is in full swing."

reason: Attackers assaulted a cyclist and stole his bicycle using force.
description_en:
On Tuesday morning, two hitherto unknown perpetrators mugged a 37-year-old man in Hastedt. The robbers fled with the man's bicycle. The police are looking for witnesses.
The 37-year-old was cycling on Hastedter Osterdeich around 7:15 AM when a man blocked his path. When the cyclist tried to get past him, the stranger kicked his handlebars, causing the 37-year-old to fall. When the attacker tried to take the bicycle, a struggle ensued. A second unknown person joined in, pushed the man from Bremen and repeatedly kicked him. The perpetrators then stole the bicycle and fled in the direction of Weserwehr. The 37-year-old man sustained injuries to his hands and knee and was treated on-site by paramedics.
The perpetrator who attacked the man from Bremen is said to have been approximately 1.80 meters tall. He had short, blonde hair, shaved short on the sides. He also has a tattoo on the right side of his neck. He was wearing blue-grey work trousers with black pocket inserts and a dark jacket.

reason: Hammer-wielding suspect threatened officers; police filed bodily-harm and threats allegations.
description_en: On Friday afternoon, a 37-year-old freaked out at a police station in Bremen-Mitte and threatened emergency personnel with a hammer. Special forces of the Bremen police overpowered the man, after emergency personnel had previously unsuccessfully deployed a Taser. The man, who was psychologically conspicuous, appeared late in the afternoon at the Mitte police station and struck windows in the entrance area with a hammer. He also threatened emergency personnel with the blunt instrument and subsequently fled. During extensive search operations, the armed man was found in the area of the Osterdeich. A Taser deployment here had no effect. He then fled to the Weser riverbank and temporarily entered the water. Alerted special forces were finally able to overpower and arrest him. He had inflicted injuries upon himself with the hammer, which required medical attention. The 37-year-old man is to be taken to a psychiatric facility for assessment. The police filed several criminal charges, including attempted grievous bodily harm and threatening behavior. Further investigations are ongoing. There were traffic obstructions around the Osterdeich and disruptions to Weser river traffic during the operation. The large-scale police operation involved, among others, rescue workers and fire department divers, as well as two police boats and one rescue boat. All closures have since been lifted.

reason: Security guard attacked and subsequently found his phone and keys missing; aggravated robbery investigation.
description_en: In the early morning hours of Sunday, a security guard on a construction site in the Old Town was robbed and seriously injured. Police are looking for witnesses.While on patrol around 2:30 AM on a construction site in Ansgaritorstraße, a security employee was attacked from behind with a strong blow to the head by a previously unknown person. He lost consciousness as a result. When the 44-year-old woke up again, he discovered that his mobile phone and a set of keys were missing. He had to be taken to a hospital with severe head injuries.The police are investigating for aggravated robbery and ask: Who made suspicious observations in the area of the construction site in the Old Town at the relevant time?

reason: Group assaulted and threatened man using spray, bats and a firearm.
description_en:
In Neustadt, several assailants attacked a 34-year-old man with baseball bats and pepper spray late on Wednesday evening. The 34-year-old had to be taken to a hospital. The police were able to identify two suspects during the night and are looking for further witnesses.

Around 11:10 PM, the 34-year-old was in Langemarckstrasse when he was sprayed with pepper spray by three individuals and knocked to the ground. Afterwards, the assailants punched and kicked him, with baseball bats also reportedly being used. One of the men then allegedly held a firearm to the man's head and threatened him with death. The 34-year-old was eventually able to flee into a snack bar and was taken to a hospital for outpatient treatment. The trio fled in a black car.

Alarmed emergency forces were able to apprehend and provisionally arrest a suspect at the owner's address a short time later. In the 20-year-old's car, police found two baseball bats with bloodstains and a knife; these were confiscated as evidence. In the course of the investigation, an 18-year-old was identified as another suspected perpetrator during the night. The police cordoned off the crime scene, secured evidence, and spoke with initial witnesses on site.

The background of the crime and possible prior relationships between those involved are now part of the investigation. The police are investigating for dangerous bodily harm and threats and are looking for further witnesses to the incident.

reason: Cancellation/update of a missing-person notice; no substantive offense established.
description_en: The 19-year-old Marc-Patrice Wendel from Bremerhaven is no longer missing. The young man was reported missing by his family on 12/13/22, see also press release 0778. The Bremen police request the deletion of the wanted notice and the photo.

reason: Two separate incidents of knife threats to obtain money and an e-scooter.
description_en: On late Tuesday evening, two robberies occurred involving the use of a knife. Witnesses are sought for the crime in Osterholz, while in the Bahnhofsvorstadt, emergency services apprehended two suspects as part of the search operation. Firstly, a 17-year-old was on his way home in Osterholz around 11 PM when he was engaged in conversation by three people at the corner of Homfelder Straße / Grenzwehr. The trio promptly demanded the teenager's valuables while brandishing a knife. When he handed over his cash but refused to give up his smartphone, one of the perpetrators made stabbing motions with the knife towards the 17-year-old, causing him a minor injury. Subsequently, the three repeatedly kicked and punched him before fleeing undetected. The teenager had to be treated in a hospital due to the injuries he sustained. One of the perpetrators wore a purple Nike jacket, light blue jeans, a white mask over his mouth, and had black hair. The second was described as slim with a black hoodie, and the third as corpulent with a black winter jacket. Just a few minutes later, around 11:10 PM, two people in the Bahnhofsvorstadt robbed a 44-year-old and a 51-year-old man of an e-scooter. In this case too, the perpetrators threatened with a knife. Only a few minutes later, emergency services apprehended two suspects on Ostertorsteinweg as part of the search operation. They still had the previously stolen e-scooter with them. The duo was taken to a police station for further police measures.

reason: Perpetrators used force, including punches and a knife injury, to steal bicycles.
description_en:
On Monday evening, a married couple in Blumenthal was mugged by previously unknown perpetrators. The robbers fled with the couple's bikes. The police are looking for witnesses.
The 44-year-old man and his 39-year-old wife were out with their new bicycles. When the couple took a break at Blumenthal bus station around 8 PM, they were accosted by a group of young men. The attackers tugged at the bikes, which led to a scuffle. Subsequently, the woman was punched in the face and her husband was injured on the hand with a knife. Afterwards, the perpetrators stole the bicycles and fled in an unknown direction. The couple ran home, from where they later alerted the police in the evening. Search operations were unsuccessful.
The police are looking for witnesses. The six to eight perpetrators are believed to be between 20 and 35 years old. They stole a green and a blue Elops brand women's city bike, model 520LF.

title_en: Christopher Street Day, Football and Events
reason: Advance CSD, concert and football traffic/event advisory.
description_en: On Saturday, several events are taking place in Bremen for which Bremen Police expects partially significant traffic disruptions. On Sunday evening, SV Werder Bremen plays against Eintracht Frankfurt at the wohninvest-Weserstadion. On Saturday, the Christopher Street Day (CSD) will take place in Bremen, which Bremen Police will accompany, as in previous years. The CSD organizer and Bremen Police expect approximately 12,000 to 15,000 participants. Along the parade route (from 12:00 PM), starting from Altenwall via Herdentorsteinweg, Bahnhofsplatz, Bürgermeister-Smid-Straße, Obernstraße, Domsheide, and finally Ostertorsteinweg, extensive traffic measures will be in place. Detours will be set up. Drivers familiar with the area are asked to bypass it widely. From 4:00 PM to 12:00 AM, there will be a follow-up rally in front of the Kunsthalle. However, Ostertorsteinweg will already be closed between Contrescarpe and Am Wall from 9:00 AM. We wish all CSD guests a great and peaceful afternoon. Additionally, concerts will take place on Bürgerweide from 4:30 PM and in the ÖVB Arena from 6:00 PM. Due to the high number of visitors, Bremen Police will also implement traffic measures here. Traffic disruptions are to be expected. During this time, this area should be avoided, or public transport or bicycles should be used. For the Bundesliga match on Sunday at 5:30 PM, traffic disruptions are to be expected, especially around the Weserstadion. The familiar traffic concept will be applied again. This means that Osterdeich will be closed to individual traffic between Sielwall and Stader Straße approximately two and a half hours before and about one hour after the end of the match. Bremen Police therefore recommends that spectators arriving by vehicle use the offered Park+Ride service from Hemelinger Hafendamm.

title_en: Police apprehend suspects after attempted break-in
reason: Witness observed suspects trying to force the door of an occupied house.
description_en:
On Tuesday morning, two suspected burglars attempted to break into a detached house in Arsten. An attentive neighbor observed the unknown individuals, picked up the phone, and called 110. Quickly arriving emergency forces apprehended two teenagers.

Around 06:30 AM, a 62-year-old woman observed two unknown individuals loitering on her driveway in Alfred-Henke-Straße and in the neighbor's garden. The witness further saw how the young men then tampered with her neighbor's front door and tried to force it open. Additionally, the suspects rang her doorbell several times, presumably to check if anyone was home. When the 87-year-old resident opened the front door, they fled. The 62-year-old dialed 110. Quickly alerted emergency forces were able to apprehend two 17-year-old teenagers. They had a laptop, several sneakers, jewelry, and keys with them. Emergency forces took the teenagers to the police station and secured the valuables. Police officers filed a criminal complaint against the duo for attempted burglary.

reason: Person accidentally shot his own hand with a blank gun; police seized several weapons.
description_en:
On the night from Wednesday to Thursday, an 18-year-old shot himself in the hand with a blank gun. Alerted emergency services seized this weapon and other airsoft guns, knives, and machetes, as well as ammunition, during a subsequent search of the apartment. The man was slightly injured in the incident and was temporarily arrested.

Around 01:30 AM, the 18-year-old called the fire department's emergency number. He stated that he had shot himself in the hand in his apartment on Hemmstraße. When alerted police forces arrived at his house, the youth stepped out the door with the weapon in his hand. He complied with the request to drop the weapon. At his apartment door, officers discovered additional weapons and knives readily accessible. The emergency services restrained the 18-year-old, handcuffed him, and temporarily arrested him. Paramedics treated his minor hand injuries. According to his own statements, he had shot himself in the hand while trying out the blank gun.

A subsequent breathalyzer test showed a value of more than 1 per mille. During a subsequent ordered search of the apartment, police found an airsoft pistol and an airsoft rifle, as well as cartridges, magazines, and ammunition. They also discovered a machete and five other knives. Emergency services seized the weapons and filed criminal charges against him. After the measures were concluded, the 18-year-old was assessed at a psychiatric clinic.

title_en: Street robbers make off with expensive jewelry
reason: Necklaces and watch forcibly ripped from victims; force was used to take property.
description_en:
On Saturday, a 61-year-old man from Bremen in Findorff and a 68-year-old woman in Osterholz fell victim to street robbers. In both cases, the perpetrators managed to escape unrecognized with valuable jewelry, including a luxury wristwatch. The police are looking for witnesses.

The 68-year-old woman was walking on Schevemoorer Landstraße towards Graubündener Straße around 1 PM when three teenagers came towards her. As they passed, one of the boys suddenly ripped four gold chains from her neck. The trio then fled in the direction of Graubündener Straße. The senior citizen remained unharmed. The robbers were described as being between 15 and 18 years old and having a dark complexion. The necklaces are gold jewelry with various symbolic pendants, such as a broken heart and letters.

Around 5:30 PM, a tourist couple from Italy alerted the police. Shortly before, the 61-year-old and his partner were on their way from Bürgerweide towards Parkhotel when an unknown person pushed between them. In doing so, he ripped the watch from the 61-year-old's wrist. The strap then broke, and the robber fled with the watch case towards Nelson-Mandela-Park. The perpetrator is said to be about 1.75 meters tall, between 20 and 30 years old, and slender. He had shoulder-length dark hair, was darkly dressed, and unkempt. The stolen item is a Rolex brand wristwatch.

reason: Group violently attacked victims and stole valuables; aggravated robbery investigated.
description_en: Four street robbers attacked a teenager and three men in the Old Town on the night from Friday to Saturday. The attackers stole a backpack, smartphone, and other valuables. They injured the 15-year-old and a 27-year-old man so severely that they had to receive outpatient treatment in hospitals. The quartet, equipped with a telescopic baton and a chain, attacked the four individuals, aged between 15 and 30, around 2:45 AM on Weserpromenade, near Tiefer street. The attackers kicked and beat the passers-by and then fled on foot with their loot towards the district. The police are looking for witnesses. The robbers were described as approximately 20 years old, with a dark complexion and black hair. One was wearing a white T-shirt, his companion a black sweater with a white emblem on the back. The four men were reportedly accompanied by a woman. Bremen Police are investigating for aggravated robbery.

reason: Wedding motorcade obstructed motorists and led to road-traffic criminal complaints.
description_en:
In Bremen-Gröpelingen, a wedding motorcade caused dangerous situations in traffic on Friday evening. The police stopped the drivers and penalized violations.

Several callers reported a wedding motorcade on the A27 motorway to the police, which then moved towards Gröpelingen. The vehicles obstructed other road users by abrupt braking and low speed. Emergency personnel checked the ten cars and their occupants on Gröpelinger Heerstraße. Some incorrigible individuals disagreed with the police measures and behaved uncooperatively. After the inspection was completed, the emergency personnel allowed the cars to drive away individually, filed a criminal complaint for coercion in road traffic, and several administrative offense reports, including for using a mobile phone while driving.

The Bremen Police explicitly points out that so-called motorcades can cause dangers for other road users. The joy about an event at no time justifies the disregard of traffic rules.

reason: Group beat victims and used pepper spray, causing injuries.
description_en: On Sunday evening, a confrontation occurred between two groups on Hollerallee in the area of Hollersee. Pepper spray is also said to have been used. Several people were injured. Police were called to Bürgerpark via emergency services. Witnesses had observed a confrontation between two groups there. In the green belt of Hollersee, the alerted emergency services encountered a group of young Syrians. They stated that they had been beaten and kicked by approximately 25 attackers. Pepper spray was also sprayed. The group of perpetrators then fled undetected. Five of the total six affected individuals, aged 20 to 23, had sustained injuries that required medical treatment. A 23-year-old had evidently suffered eye irritation due to the pepper spray attack. He also sustained a laceration to the head and facial injuries. The young men received initial medical care from paramedics on site, and two were taken to the hospital. An alleged group of perpetrators could not be located during search operations. The attackers were described as wearing dark clothing and having a dark complexion. The criminal police are investigating dangerous bodily harm and are seeking witnesses.

title_en: Unknown stabs Werder fan in the neck
reason: Person was stabbed in the neck by an unknown attacker.
description_en: A 53-year-old man sought treatment at a hospital in Kattenturm during the night from Tuesday to Wednesday with a stab wound to his neck. The Bremen resident stated that he had been injured with a knife shortly before by an unknown assailant due to his Werder sympathies. The 53-year-old had been watching the home game of SV Werder Bremen against Borussia Dortmund on television at his home on Arsterdamm street. After the final whistle, he went outside in his Werder fan clothing to get some fresh air. A man approached him and asked if he was a Werder fan. Subsequently, the unknown assailant stabbed him in the neck with a knife and fled on foot in the direction of Kattenturmer Heerstraße. The injured man, who was under the influence of alcohol, then went to the hospital, from where the police were later called. He was later discharged after outpatient treatment. The police ask: "Who observed the altercation between 10 PM and 11 PM in the junction area of Arsterdamm and Auf dem Beginenlande streets, who can provide information about the perpetrator?" The attacker was described as approximately 180 centimeters tall, with brown hair.

reason: Three women allegedly stole goods from a shop; further stolen merchandise was recovered.
description_en:
On Monday afternoon, three female thieves attempted to steal baby equipment from a specialty store in Burglesum. During a subsequent house search, numerous high-value household appliances, clothing, and e-bikes were seized.

The owner of the baby specialty store, along with two other witnesses, observed around 5:30 PM how three women pushed a stroller out of her store on Hindenburgstraße without having paid. Thereupon, the owner alerted the police. The quickly arriving officers encountered three women aged 32, 27, and 18, and secured the stolen goods. During further investigations, additional presumably stolen merchandise was found in a car they were using. This included several smartphones, sweaters, shoes, and underwear. Thereupon, the car was confiscated. During subsequent ordered house searches, numerous high-value goods worth several thousand euros, some still in original packaging, could be seized.

The women were temporarily arrested and processed by criminal identification services. One of them belongs to a large Bremen family. Bremen Police, as part of its zero-tolerance strategy, exhausts all legal possibilities and consistently acts against clan criminality. The police are now investigating the three suspects for organized theft.

title_en: Police operation after altercation in the neighborhood
reason: Witnesses reported a physical confrontation; actual injuries and roles are limited.
description_en:
Several emergency calls led to a police deployment in the neighborhood early Saturday afternoon. Witnesses reported a physical altercation between several men on Ziegenmarkt, during which one person was said to have carried a knife.

Quickly arriving emergency services encountered a 26-year-old man in the area of Wielandstraße/Friesenstraße. He was carrying a knife in his waistband. After being clearly addressed, the man put down the knife and was subsequently brought to the ground and secured.

Subsequently, a summoned crisis service assessed the 26-year-old. An acute mental illness was diagnosed. The man was then taken to a hospital.

On site, the emergency services conducted extensive witness interviews. At least one other participant in the altercation could be identified. According to current findings, no one was seriously injured. Further investigations are ongoing.

title_en: Incidents during the bicycle parade of Werder supporters
reason: Tram driver was attacked during a football fan procession; the report contains several incident types.
description_en: Before SV Werder Bremen's first home game against Bayer 04 Leverkusen, several incidents occurred on Saturday afternoon in connection with a fan event. Around 12:30 PM, approximately 600 supporters of SV Werder Bremen started a joint bicycle procession from the Unisee towards the Weserstadion. At the Stern junction, participants initially broke through a police barrier and were subsequently stopped by police forces in the area of the Gustav-Deetjen-Tunnel at the main train station. Here, isolated coercive measures were taken as individuals again attempted to break through a police line. After continuing their journey, the procession did not adhere to the agreed route. In the area of the Sielwall junction, a minor traffic accident subsequently occurred between a cyclist from the group and a tram. The cyclist then hit the tram's window, whereupon the driver exited. Immediately thereafter, several people attacked the tram driver, who sustained minor injuries. Police forces intervened immediately and freed the man using direct force, including physical force and batons. Furthermore, during the operation, Bremen Ultras insultingly disparaged police forces who had come from Bavaria to Bremen to provide support.

title_en: Police for the Bundesliga match Werder vs. Bayern
reason: Football-match operational roundup with several secondary offenses; primary focus is event reporting.
description_en: On Saturday afternoon, SV Werder Bremen and FC Bayern München faced each other in the sold-out Weserstadion. The afternoon proceeded without major incidents; pyrotechnics were ignited in the stadium by home fans. Bremen police registered few event-typical criminal offenses during the afternoon, such as assault, property damage, and theft. Corresponding criminal charges were filed, and investigations into these are ongoing. Fan marches during the arrival and departure of home and away fans occasionally led to traffic disruptions. Masked Werder supporters ignited various pyrotechnics, such as smoke pots, in the stadium's Ostkurve. One person sustained eye injuries in the process. Here too, the police have launched investigations.

title_en: Spirits in the dumpster: Police catch two thieves
reason: Food and drink stolen from a forced-open refrigerated container; possible burglary/theft boundary.
description_en:
On Friday night, Bremen police officers stopped a 22-year-old man and a 23-year-old woman who were walking through the Neustadt district with two garbage cans. During a check, the officers found several cartons of spirits and cakes in the garbage cans, which they had previously stolen from a refrigerated container.

Around 3:30 AM, officers on patrol on Neustadtcontrescarpe street noticed two people approaching them, each with a garbage can. When the officers asked the woman and the man what they were doing there, they stated that they had found the garbage cans in a nearby park. When the officers looked into the garbage cans, they discovered several cartons with various beverages and other foodstuffs. Another patrol car was called in, which discovered a broken-into refrigerated container in the aforementioned park. This, as well as the beverages and foodstuffs, could be attributed to a café.

The 23-year-old woman and the 22-year-old man were provisionally arrested. A complaint for aggravated theft was filed against the duo. Further investigations are ongoing.

reason: Gunshot victim and attempted-homicide investigation; codebook lacks separate homicide/attempted-homicide category.
description_en:
In the night leading to Saturday, police were called to an incident in Gröpelingen. There, they encountered a 49-year-old man with a gunshot wound. The man was taken to a hospital and underwent surgery. There is no danger to his life. The police are looking for witnesses.

Police were called to Güstrower Straße around 3 AM. Witnesses had observed a man with a leg injury there. Upon arrival, alerted emergency services found a 49-year-old man with a gunshot wound. After initial medical treatment of his wound, he was taken to a hospital and immediately operated on. Among other things, a firearm and ammunition were found in a bush nearby and secured as evidence. The background to the injury is the subject of ongoing investigations.

The criminal police are currently investigating on suspicion of attempted homicide.

title_en: Police investigating after knife found in playground
reason: A knife was discovered on a playground, but no assailant, threat or specific offense was established.
description_en: A knife on a primary school playground in the Neustadt triggered a police operation on Thursday morning. Primary school children discovered an open pocket knife in a sandpit on the school grounds at Kantstraße while playing in the morning, with the blade still sticking up. No one was injured. The students informed the school administration, and the police were alerted. The criminal police have launched an investigation, and the SOKO Spielplatz (Special Commission Playground) is examining connections.

reason: Freimarkt activity summary aggregates assaults, thefts and other offenses; not one incident.
description_en:
The Bremen police look back on a busy but also peaceful Freimarkt this year. Assaults, thefts, violations of the Narcotics Act, but also traffic offenders kept the emergency services of the Freimarkt police station busy. The Freimarkt was very well attended in the two weeks with approximately 1.5 million guests. The police had the most to do on weekends. According to current figures, the emergency services recorded 43 assault offenses. The number of violent crimes has decreased compared to the last Freimarkt in 2022. In addition, the police recorded fewer thefts this year compared to 2022, with a total of 24 incidents reported. In eight cases, the criminal police are investigating sexual harassment. Furthermore, the police confiscated various narcotics and weapons. This year, too, the cooperation with the awareness teams went very well. In addition, a video trailer of the Bremen police was used on the premises for the first time.

This year, too, traffic wardens from the public order office had illegally parked vehicles towed away, a total of 341, and issued 1406 administrative offense notices.

reason: Investigations mention incitement to hatred and banned association; confirm primary category against codebook.
description_en: The State Security Department of the Bremen Police searched houses and apartments of several accused individuals in Bremen in December and January, who belong to a banned Reichsbürger movement. The background to this is investigations into proceedings for violation of the ban on associations and incitement to hatred by the Lower Saxony Police. In the course of these Lower Saxony proceedings, further accused individuals were identified in Bremen who are suspected of having violated the ban on associations. On December 1, 2022, the police in Sebaldsbrück searched the house of a 55-year-old man belonging to a Reichsbürger association. During this, the investigators also seized a two-ton stele which was meant to symbolize a border stone.

reason: Cars with Ukrainian plates were damaged; possible political motive was under investigation, not proven.
description_en:
Unknown individuals damaged several vehicles with Ukrainian license plates in Bremen during the past two nights. The Bremen police have launched investigations and are looking for witnesses.
In the night from Friday to Saturday, tires of a total of five cars were slashed in Findorffallee and Friedrich-Rauers-Straße. In the night from Saturday to Sunday, unknown individuals smashed windows and headlights of two parked cars in Kölner Straße. All vehicles had Ukrainian license plates. Other parked cars with German license plates remained undamaged at these locations. Property damage of several thousand Euros was incurred. The State Security Department of the Bremen Police is investigating for a politically motivated act.

reason: Vaccination-certificate forgery/sale is central; existing fraud category is limited to obtaining assets.
description_en: Bremen police searched the apartment of an employee of a Bremen doctor's practice this week. The 29-year-old is under urgent suspicion of having produced and distributed forged vaccination certificates. The Bremen resident worked in a group practice in Findorff and had access to vaccine doses, stickers with batch numbers, and blank vaccination certificates. The investigators received a tip that the 29-year-old woman was forging and selling vaccination certificates in her apartment. A search warrant was obtained from the district court via the Bremen public prosecutor's office and executed on Wednesday. The emergency services found what they were looking for and confiscated 14 blank vaccination books, 74 batch stickers, three already forged vaccination books, and three stamps that were stolen from the practice in autumn 2021. Police officers were also able to seize two vaccination certificates issued in her name. Further investigations, including for theft and commercial document forgery, are ongoing. Bremen police are currently investigating 185 cases of forged vaccination certificates. Act against vaccination certificate fraud: If you want to post a picture of your vaccination certificate on Facebook, Instagram and the like, you should consider the following. Criminals use the data spread in this way (e.g. the pictured batch number of the vaccine or the address) to forge vaccination certificates and offer them for sale online. The fact is: Not only the perpetrators commit a crime, but also the buyers. Anyone who uses such a forged vaccination certificate is committing a criminal offense. Report offers or advertisements for forged vaccination certificates to the police and the network operator.

title_en: Witnesses sought after sexual harassment in Mahndorf
reason: Unwanted sexual touching is central; codebook lacks a separate sexual-offenses category.
description_en:
Early Saturday morning, three unknown men harassed a 17-year-old girl in Bremen-Mahndorf. The police are looking for witnesses.

The 17-year-old got off a train at Mahndorf station around 4:15 AM to transfer to a bus there. The trio, who had already spoken to her for the first time on the train, also got off in Mahndorf. Once there, they spoke to the teenager again and did not leave her alone, even after she asked them to leave her in peace. One of them finally grabbed her buttocks and breasts. After the 17-year-old announced she would call the police with her phone, one of them knocked it out of her hand. Only after she then repeatedly screamed loudly for help did the men leave.

The three were approximately 25 to 30 years old and had dark skin. One was wearing a grey or brown top, blue jeans, light-colored shoes, and a white cap. A second reportedly wore completely dark clothing. No further description is known for the third perpetrator.

title_en: Suspicious letter in the job center
reason: Powder in a suspicious letter was harmless; no specific offense established.
description_en: A suspicious letter at the Jobcenter in Bremen-Grohn triggered a large-scale deployment of the fire brigade and police on Wednesday. Employees of the Jobcenter on Hermann-Fortmann-Straße had discovered the suspicious letter around 09:50 AM and alerted the police. After the building had been evacuated by police forces and the security service, specialists from the Federal Police secured the letter with a powdery content. The examination of the powder revealed that it was a non-hazardous substance. Further investigations by the criminal police are ongoing.

reason: Shooting of a minor with suspected attempted homicide; codebook has no separate homicide category.
description_en: Bremen police special forces arrested a 17-year-old youth and a 32-year-old man at the beginning of April after extensive investigations. There is an urgent suspicion that they were involved in the shooting of a 17-year-old in Arsten (see press release 0199). The 17-year-old youth had been found with life-threatening gunshot wounds on March 16, 2021, at the intersection of Carl-Katz-Straße/Zu den Wadeackern. After extensive analysis of evidence, witness interrogations, and further police measures by the homicide commission, the two suspects could be identified. For this purpose, the Bremen police had established a special task force (BAO). During a house search by special forces, investigators found 15 blank-firing weapons, live ammunition, a knife, a sword, and further evidence. They arrested the two 17- and 32-year-olds. At the request of the public prosecutor's office, the Bremen District Court issued warrants for pre-trial detention. The 17-year-old injured person is now no longer in life-threatening condition.

title_en: Police operations after altercation in Neustadt
reason: Physical assaults and injuries are central but report also involves drugs and a firearm.
description_en: On Friday afternoon, there was a major police operation in Neustadt after several people attacked each other, including with objects. Already on Thursday afternoon, there was initially an altercation in Neustadt, in which a 34-year-old man wielded a weapon. According to witnesses, he had retrieved this from a shop. Special forces already searched this shop on Thursday and found drugs and cash. Whether both incidents are connected is currently being investigated. At 1:15 p.m. on Thursday, emergency services were called to Kornstraße because there was said to have been an altercation in front of a kiosk there. According to witness statements, the 34-year-old shop owner had insulted a 45-year-old kiosk operator on site and shortly thereafter retrieved a firearm from a shop. He allegedly threw it away when he heard the police coming. The police found a loaded firearm nearby and secured it. They apprehended the shop owner nearby. In the course of the police operation, several people from the shop attacked the previously insulted 45-year-old, and another loud altercation broke out, which was immediately ended by the emergency services. The police conducted threat prevention talks with those involved and issued expulsion orders. In parallel, a search warrant for the shop premises, from which the 45-year-old was said to have retrieved the weapon, was issued by the district court at the request of the public prosecutor's office. During the search by special forces, drugs, cash, and prescription medications, among other things, were found. The police also confiscated various mobile phones. Around 1:30 p.m. on Friday, several people attacked each other in Kornstraße. Objects and irritant gas were also used in the process. Up to 60 people, mostly family members of the disputants, were temporarily on site. According to current findings, two people were slightly injured, and the police provisionally arrested six people by the time this press release was published. Whether there is a connection to Thursday's police operation is currently part of the investigation. The police are on site with a strong presence to calm the situation; several expulsion orders have been issued for this purpose. The background to the renewed altercation is currently being investigated.
